llm.summary: This is a markdown-only customs compliance thinking aid with no executable behavior, persistence, or hidden data access.

dimensions.detail: No local files, credentials, network tools, business systems, or external APIs are requested; external URLs are presented as informational references.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected artifact is a single non-executable SKILL.md file with no bundled scripts, dependencies, package install steps, or command execution.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are limited to when to activate the reasoning aid and what compliance checks to consider; it does not try to override agent rules, access secrets, or change unrelated behavior.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains no persistence mechanism, background worker, scheduled task, memory-writing instruction, privilege escalation, or tool modification.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill provides AD/CVD and Section 301 tariff exposure prompts, red flags, and verification reminders that match its stated customs-compliance purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, treat this as a customs compliance checklist, not legal advice. It may help flag AD/CVD, Section 301, scope, origin, and evasion questions, but users should verify current rules with authoritative sources or counsel before relying on it for import decisions.
